source_text: Non poteritis servire Domino quia Deus sanctus est — severitas ad cautionem. Populus: Serviemus. Testes vos estis. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Not you-will-be-able to-serve Lord because God holy is — severity unto caution. People: We-will-serve. Witnesses you are. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[You cannot serve the Lord, for he is a holy God >> Bible:Joshua 24:19]] — severity unto caution. The people: We will serve. You are witnesses. Amen.
